method: live hand frames recorded in -game (g10b_grip_probe_game.py) + SM_AR01 LOD0 triangles (g10b_grip_dump_cmd.py) -> offline curl solve per finger joint about local Z with anatomy limits (g10b_grip_solve.py) -> one-frame A_AR01_Grip_UEFN baked from the solved local rotations + a local-space Layered blend per bone on the finger 01 bones before L2C in ABP_GunCharacter (build_gun_grip_g10b.py)
deviations_from_plan: no C++ change: the finger layer's weight is the existing GunIKAlpha (on in Idle / Firing / SelectorChange, off in reload / draw), so GunGripAlpha and UNinjaGunData::SupportGripPoses were not added; the layer plays one fixed AR-01 pose (add the per-gun / per-skeleton map when the SMG joins)
one asset A_AR01_Grip_UEFN holds both hands (left: all five fingers; right: thumb, middle, ring, pinky; the right index keeps the clip's trigger finger)
measurements are bone-point based (pad radius 0.7 cm, plan risk 4); the close-ups show the pads on the wood with no visible gap or deep overlap
shots_dir: runs/G10/grip/ (before/ = the same views before the change)
notes: the shoulder camera (hip hold) cannot see the left hand: it is behind the right arm (08_*); it shows in shoulder aim (08c)
